<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def sqs(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='S' and n['pixels']>=8:
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((min(rs),min(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
r = action(['LEFT']*4 + ['UP'])
print("final:", sqs(current_frame), "completed:", last_action_result.get('level_completed'), "level:", current_frame.level)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
